title: Head positions in a captured call
statement: Let $B$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a state of $\mathrm{body}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Suppose $c$ is a configuration of $\mathrm{body}$ on $x$, $\mathrm{fuel}$ is a configuration of $F$ on $x$, and $\mathrm{startup}$ and $\mathrm{release}$ are Boolean values. If every work-tape head of $c$ and of $\mathrm{fuel}$ lies between $-B$ and $B$, and the output of $c$ has length at most $B$, then every work-tape head in the configuration formed by capturing this call also lies between $-B$ and $B$.
hypotheses_covered: all work-tape head positions of $c$ lie in $[-B,B]$
all work-tape head positions of $\mathrm{fuel}$ lie in $[-B,B]$
the output of $c$ has length at most $B$
